description: This Java source file defines the GatewayAuthenticationDirective class, which implements an Akka HTTP directive to perform authentication for a gateway. It manages authentication chains, handles success and failure cases, and wraps routes with authentication logic.

classes.name: GatewayAuthenticationDirective
classes.description: A final class that implements an Akka HTTP directive to manage authentication for gateway requests. It uses an authentication chain and handles success/failure routing.

methods.name: GatewayAuthenticationDirective
methods.description: Constructor initializing the directive with an authentication chain and a default exception factory.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs authentication based on request headers and wraps an inner route with authentication logic, returning a Route.

methods.name: handleAuthenticationTry
methods.description: Handles the result of the authentication attempt, proceeding with the inner route if successful, or handling failure.

methods.name: handleFailedAuthentication
methods.description: Manages failed authentication cases, logging and throwing appropriate exceptions.
